summary: Comprehensive testing of Mini-Game Duel Arena feature. All 83 backend tests pass (1 skipped). Mini-game duel lifecycle fully functional: create challenges for all 4 game types (RPS, Trivia, Simon, Whack-a-Mole), 1 or 3 round duels, accept/decline flow, round resolution, winner choice (me/them), task reassignment, XP rewards (accepted XP + winner bonus). Frontend Mini-Games tab renders correctly with all UI elements.

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility issue (pre-existing)

critical_code_review_comments: Mini-game challenge creation correctly validates: only assigned player can create, round count must be 1 or 3, task must not be completed
duelPending flag correctly blocks task completion during active duel
XP rewards correctly awarded: flat XP on accept (both players), +25% bonus to winner
Winner choice (me/them) correctly reassigns task and clears duelPending
All 4 game types (rock_paper_scissors, trivia, simon, whack_a_mole) resolve correctly
Pending challenges list correctly excludes completed/declined challenges

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Mini-Games tab renders with all UI elements)

test_credentials: None required - tests create fresh households via API
seed_data_creation: Test households created dynamically during pytest runs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mini-Game Duel Arena feature fully tested. All backend APIs working correctly. Frontend MiniGameArena component has proper data-testid attributes. Regression tests for random events, sandbox simulator, availability calendar, and verification flows all pass.

mini_game_challenge_creation.details: All 4 game types (RPS, Trivia, Simon, Whack-a-Mole) can be created with 1 or 3 rounds

challenge_validation.details: Only assigned player can create, invalid round counts rejected, completed tasks blocked

accept_decline_flow.details: Accept awards XP to both players, decline unlocks task (removes duelPending)

round_resolution.details: RPS: rock>scissors>paper>rock; Trivia: correct beats wrong, faster wins ties; Simon/Whack: higher score wins

winner_choice.details: Winner can choose 'me' or 'them' to assign task, only winner can make choice

task_reassignment.details: Task correctly reassigned to chosen player, duelPending cleared

xp_rewards.details: Flat XP on accept (both players), +25% bonus to winner

duel_pending_blocking.details: Task completion blocked while duelPending is active

3_round_duels.details: Best of 3 requires 2 wins to determine winner

frontend_mini_games_tab.details: Tab renders with task select, opponent select, game type select, round count select, create button, empty state

regression_random_events.details: Random event generation, accept/dismiss, complete with XP, pair follow-up all working

regression_sandbox_simulator.details: Sandbox creation, player perspective, task actions, event actions, schedule editing, notes, endorsements all working

regression_verification_flow.details: Task verification, approval/rejection, join flow redistribution all working

regression_availability_calendar.details: Weekly defaults and date overrides save correctly
